title: IoT reading ingestor with a JSON telemetry logger
name: Sensor reading ingestor

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code records structured log events? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A caller passes data { level: "debug", service: "x" } to info(). What do the level and service fields of the emitted line contain?
choices: "debug" and "x", because data is spread after base
"info" and the logger's configured service, because they are written after the spread
The call throws because level is reserved

questions.prompt: A gateway sends 10 readings, 3 of which have value NaN. What does accept() do?
choices: Rejects the whole batch and returns 0
Buffers 7, logs one warn line with dropped 3 and received 10, and returns 7
Buffers 7 and logs a warn line per dropped reading

questions.prompt: writeBatch rejects during flush(). What happens to the batch that was being written?
choices: It is put back at the front of the buffer so a later flush retries it
It is discarded and only counted in the log line
It is moved to the end of the buffer behind newer readings
It stays out of the buffer until flushing is reset
